details.description:
ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary Health Nutrition: Since 1968, Royal Canin has been following the belief that nutrition plays a key role in supporting the health and wellbeing of cats and dogs. This is why we have designed ROYAL CANIN® veterinary diets around proven nutritional science in partnership with pet professionals and experts, delivering nutrition for pets with specific health needs. 

Some dogs may have nutritional intolerances or adverse reactions to certain foods. In these cases, a specifically tailored hypoallergenic diet for dogs, sometimes mistakenly called an allergy dog food,  can help to support their wellbeing. ROYAL CANIN® Hypoallergenic dry dog food is a precisely balanced, nutritious diet that is specially formulated to meet the nutritional needs of adult dogs with a nutrient intolerance.

ROYAL CANIN® Hypoallergenic  dry dog food is suitable for:
•	Dogs with Adverse Food Reactions
•	Dogs with dermatological and/or gastro-intestinal signs of a food intolerance
•	Food intolerance

Key Benefits:
•	Hydrolysed protein 
o	This formula contains hydrolysed protein with low molecular weight for very low allergenicity. 
•	EPA/DHA & skin barrier 
o	This is formulated to support the natural protective barrier role of your dog's skin. 
•	Digestive health 
o	The diet helps to regulate intestinal transit and supports a balanced digestive flora.

 As part of the ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary Range, it is important that this product is only fed to your pet when recommended by a veterinary professional. Transitioning your pet from one diet to another should be a smooth and gradual process over a 7-10-day period. Please ensure you follow the correct rationing amount, especially when mix-feeding. 

To cater to each dog's individual preferences, ROYAL CANIN® Hypoallergenic is also available as a wet food (loaf texture).

Please note: Royal Canin Hypoallergenic is not suitable for growth, pregnancy, lactation, or dogs with pancreatitis.

These tasty chews not only complement your dog’s Hypoallergenic diet plan without compromising the benefits of their main meal diet, but also reflect a thoughtful choice that supports their wellbeing.

Enjoy  the moment with your dog with these tasty chews
When  it comes to your dog’s health and wellbeing, we know you want only the best  for them. That’s why we created ROYAL CANIN® Hypoallergenic Treats, so you can  reward your dog without compromising the health benefits of their carefully  balanced hypoallergenic diet plan. 
Developed  by experts in canine nutrition, these soft, tasty chews are suitable for dogs  over 6 months old.
Contains  hydrolysed protein and vitamin B12
ROYAL  CANIN® Hypoallergenic Treats are formulated with hydrolysed protein and  vitamin B12, making them a great option for dogs with food sensitivities.  
When  you reward your dog with ROYAL CANIN® Hypoallergenic Treats, you’re not just  giving them something tasty; you are proactively supporting their veterinary  diet plan. 
Follow  the on-pack feeding guidelines
Be  sure to follow the on-pack feeding guidelines and give your dog no more than  the recommended number of treats per day. 
When  treating your canine companion, it is advisable to adjust the portion size of  their main meal to help keep them at a healthy weight.
Compatible  with ROYAL CANIN® Hypoallergenic diets 
ROYAL  CANIN® Hypoallergenic Treats are compatible with the following Hypoallergenic  diets from our dedicated ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary range, which should only be  given to your pet under veterinary recommendation:

RECOMMENDED FOR CASES OF
• Adverse Food Reactions (AFR) with dermatologic and/or gastrointestinal signs (food elimination trial/long term management)
• Canine Atopic Dermatitis (CAD) associated with AFR +/- chronic pruritus
• Chronic diarrhoea
• Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD)
• Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency (EPI)
• Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth (SIBO)

NOT RECOMMENDED IN CASE OF
• Pancreatitis
• Gestation/lactation
